note: Featured poets and authors. Nothing appears here without an explicit, revocable, non-exclusive display grant from the writer, recorded per piece. A writer keeps every other right, including the right to have their work taken down: on request it comes down, no questions asked.

shape.slug: kebab-case, used as the profile anchor and joined from a listing's writers array
shape.name: as they want it printed
shape.bio: two or three sentences, theirs if they sent one

pieces.text: the piece itself, line breaks preserved as
pieces.note: optional: where it first appeared, or a note from the writer
pieces.grantedOn: YYYY-MM-DD, the date they agreed to the terms on submit.html
